fields.summary_ko.0: TSM has recorded three consecutive quarters of earnings beats but has declined approximately 11% over the past month despite AI demand exceeding supply; 12-month target price of $516.16 implies 27.09% upside with buy ratings.
fields.summary_ko.1: The critical question is whether the company can convert surging AI demand into profitability; the CFO stated "revenue growth rates will exceed capital expenditure growth rates"; if Q4 revenue guidance midpoint (approximately 58% growth) is achieved, the bull case target price reaches $536.47.
